characters.continuity: The Lord of the Rings (Books / Film Trilogy)
characters.summary: Samwise Gamgee is a steadfast Hobbit who fights with a simple Elven dagger (Sting) and his trusty frying pan when necessary. Though physically small, his immense loyalty and refusal to surrender give him remarkable endurance against physical and psychological corruption.

techniques: improvised melee with sword or pan

mechanisms: exceptional mental resilience against the One Ring

weaknesses: limited reach and lack of heavy armor
limitations: mortal endurance and strength limitations of a hobbit

sources.supports: Basic summary of Samwise Gamgee, weapons, and endurance.

feats.claim: Wounded the giant spider Shelob using the Elven dagger Sting.
feats.citation: The Two Towers / The Return of the King

notableResults.note: Fought defensively with Sting and the Phial of Galadriel to drive the creature away.

campaignTags.claim: Uses an Elven-made cloak granted by Galadriel that aids in concealment.

unknowns: Exact limits of his resistance to magical corruption over long periods.

characters.continuity: The Lord of the Rings (Books / Film Trilogy)
characters.summary: Saruman the White is a powerful Istar (Wizard) wielding potent magic, voice-based persuasion, and a vast network of spies and orc armies. He relies on spellcasting, telekinesis, and his Staff of Power.
weaknesses: loss of magical potency when his staff is broken
limitations: power tied to his staff and spiritual station as an Istar

sources.supports: Saruman's status as a wizard, his staff, and his defeat by Gandalf.

feats.claim: Cast a spell on the mountain pass of Caradhras causing severe weather disruption.

notableResults.citation: The Fellowship of the Ring (Orthanc confrontation)
notableResults.note: Defeated and stripped of his formal office by Gandalf the White.

campaignTags.claim: Wields potent Istari magic and spellcasting abilities.

unknowns: The full extent of his mechanical crafting abilities compared to Sauron.

characters.continuity: The Lord of the Rings (Books / Film Trilogy)
characters.summary: Having rejected his white mantle, Saruman adopts multi-colored robes that shift and dazzle the eye, reflecting his complete embrace of self-declared supremacy and fragmented magical pursuits.

mechanisms: Shifting iridescent robes that confuse observers

characters.formDifferences: Replaces white robes with shifting multi-colored garments symbolizing his abandonment of the White Council's mission.

sources.supports: Saruman proclaiming himself Saruman of Many Colours.

campaignTags.claim: Retains all wizardly spellcasting capacities with altered manifestation.

unknowns: Whether the multi-colored robes grant any specific physical defense beyond optical confusion.

characters.continuity: The Lord of the Rings (Books / Film Trilogy)
characters.summary: Sauron is a fallen Maia and the Dark Lord of Mordor, commanding terrifying dark magic, immense physical strength in armored form, and overwhelming telepathic influence. He dominates through fear, armies, and lingering spiritual malice.

techniques: mental domination via the Palantir or direct will

mechanisms: near-immortal spirit form unless his essence is completely dispersed

weaknesses: reliance on the existence of the One Ring to anchor his full power
vulnerability of his physical body to overwhelming force
limitations: cannot easily manifest a physical form without anchors of power

sources.supports: Sauron's nature as a Dark Lord, his combat capabilities, and his armor.

feats.claim: Slain Elendil and Gil-galad during the siege of Barad-dûr, though sustaining mortal injury in return.
feats.citation: The Fellowship of the Ring prologue

notableResults.citation: The Silmarillion / Fellowship of the Ring prologue
notableResults.note: Killed both kings in single combat before being overthrown by Isildur.

campaignTags.claim: Possesses ancient and powerful dark magic as a corrupted Maia.

unknowns: Exact details of his physical combat capabilities prior to the forging of the One Ring.

characters.continuity: The Silmarillion / The Lord of the Rings (History)
characters.summary: In his fair guise as Annatar, Sauron acts as a master craftsman and deceptive diplomat, manipulating the Elves of Eregion through advanced knowledge of metallurgy and magic rather than open warfare.

mechanisms: Disguise as an emissary of the Valar

weaknesses: vulnerable to exposure if his true identity is verified by high authorities like Gil-galad or Elrond
characters.formDifferences: Adopts a fair, charismatic physical appearance to deceive opponents rather than wearing terrifying dark battle armor.

sources.supports: Annatar persona and the deception of the Elves of Eregion.

campaignTags.claim: Masterminded the advanced craft and lore behind the Rings of Power.
Utilizes subtle magical craft and illusion to maintain his fair form.

unknowns: The exact combative potency of the Annatar form compared to his armored Dark Lord manifestation.

characters.continuity: The Lord of the Rings (Books / Film Trilogy)
characters.summary: Equipped with the One Ring, Sauron's innate power is vastly amplified, allowing him to dominate the wills of others, project overwhelming intimidation, and command absolute authority over all lesser ring-bearers.
weaknesses: the Ring remains a physical point of vulnerability if severed from his hand
characters.formDifferences: Wears the One Ring on his hand, which multiplies his native power and dominion over Middle-earth.

sources.supports: The One Ring's amplification of Sauron's power.

campaignTags.claim: Channeling the One Ring maximizes his innate dark magic and dominion.

unknowns: Whether any single mortal combatant could match him one-on-one while he wields the Ring without divine intervention.

characters.continuity: The Lord of the Rings (Books / Film Trilogy)
characters.summary: Shagrat is a brutal Uruk-hai captain of the Tower of Cirith Ungol, fighting with cruel blade weapons and commanding subordinate orcs through fear and violence.
limitations: limited tactical vision outside of brute force

sources.supports: Shagrat's role as an orc captain at Cirith Ungol.

feats.claim: Fought and killed Gorbag in a fierce dispute over Frodo's mithril coat.

notableResults.note: Killed Gorbag during a brutal clash between rival orc factions.

unknowns: Exact fate after escaping with the mithril coat.

characters.continuity: The Lord of the Rings (Books / Film Trilogy)
characters.summary: Shelob is an ancient, giant spider monster who preys on living things by injecting paralyzing venom and binding victims in thick webbing.

mechanisms: Extremely tough chitinous hide resistant to normal swords

weaknesses: extreme vulnerability to bright light (such as the Phial of Galadriel) and sharp Elven steel (Sting)
limitations: blinded or repelled by intense magical illumination

sources.supports: Shelob's nature as a giant spider, her venom, and her lair.

feats.claim: Successfully paralyzed Frodo Baggins with her venomous sting in her lair.

notableResults.note: Ambushed and paralyzed Frodo before being driven off by Samwise.
Repelled and severely wounded by Sam wielding Sting and the Phial of Galadriel.

campaignTags.claim: An enormous primordial spider monster far larger than ordinary animals.

unknowns: Her exact age and origin prior to settling in the Ephel Dúath.

characters.summary: Smaug the Magnificent is a colossal, intelligent, fire-breathing dragon possessing devastating offensive power, armored scales, and hypnotic speech.

mechanisms: Impenetrable armored scales covering almost his entire body

weaknesses: a single bare patch on his underbelly unprotected by armor
limitations: arrogance and excessive pride in his invulnerability

sources.supports: Smaug's status as a fire-drake, his armored scales, and his weakness.

feats.claim: Destroyed the city of Dale and conquered the Lonely Mountain in a single surprise attack.

notableResults.note: Slain when Bard shot a black arrow into his unprotected chest gap.

campaignTags.claim: Produces devastating torrents of dragon-fire from his mouth.
Possesses massive wings allowing powerful flight.
A gigantic dragon large enough to demolish buildings and mountainsides.

unknowns: The full extent of his magical persuasion abilities beyond standard dragon-spells.

characters.summary: Tar-Aldarion was the sixth King of Númenor and a legendary mariner who excelled in navigation, shipbuilding, and maritime exploration, relying on exceptional leadership and seafaring expertise.

mechanisms: exceptional physical conditioning of the Dunedain

limitations: bound by mortal constraints and political duties to his realm

sources.supports: Tar-Aldarion's history as a Númenórean king and master mariner.

feats.claim: Established extensive tree-planting and conservation policies to support Númenor's shipbuilding industry.

notableResults.note: Successfully forged strategic alliances with the Elves of Lindon during his voyages.

campaignTags.claim: Master mariner and captain of great royal fleets.

unknowns: Specific combat engagements against named adversaries in minor skirmishes.
